verses.1:1: Now King David was old, advanced in days, and they covered him with garments, yet he did not grow warm.
verses.1:2: And his servants said, "Let them seek a young virgin for the king, and she shall stand before the king and shall cherish him, and lie with him, and my lord the king shall be warmed."
verses.1:3: So they sought a fair young woman from all the territory of Israel, and they found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.1:4: And the young woman was exceedingly fair; and she cherished the king and ministered to him, yet the king did not know her.
verses.1:5: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, "I will reign." And he prepared for himself chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.1:6: And his father had never restrained him, saying, "Why have you done this?" Moreover, he also was very handsome in appearance, and she bore him after Absalom.
verses.1:7: And his words were with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest, and they gave aid following Adonijah.
verses.1:8: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty sons of David were not following Adonijah.
verses.1:9: And Adonijah sacrificed sheep and calves and lambs with Aithe of Zoheleth, who was beside Rogel; and he invited his brothers and the notable men of Judah, the servants of the king.
verses.1:10: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother he did not invite.
verses.1:11: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, "Have you not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith has become king, and our lord David does not know it?
verses.1:12: And now come, please let me give you counsel, and deliver your life and the life of your son Solomon.
verses.1:13: Come, go in to King David and say to him, 'Did you not, my lord, O king, swear to your maidservant, saying, "Your son Solomon shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne"? Why then has Adonijah become king?'
verses.1:14: And behold, while you are still speaking there with the king, I also will come in afterward and fulfill your words."
verses.1:15: So Bathsheba went in to the king into the chamber; and the king was very old, and Abishag the Shunammite was ministering to the king.
verses.1:16: And Bathsheba bowed and did obeisance to the king; and the king said, "What do you wish?"
verses.1:17: And she said, "My lord, you swore by your God to your maidservant, saying, 'Your son Solomon shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.'
verses.1:18: And now, behold, Adonijah has become king, and you, my lord, O king, did not know it.
verses.1:19: He has sacrificed calves and lambs and sheep in abundance, and has invited all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the commander of the army; but Solomon your servant he did not invite.
verses.1:20: And as for you, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon you, to declare to them who shall sit upon the throne of my lord the king after him.
verses.1:21: And it shall come to pass, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be offenders."
verses.1:22: And behold, while she was still speaking with the king, Nathan the prophet came.
verses.1:23: And it was told to the king, "Behold, Nathan the prophet." And he went in before the king, and did obeisance to the king with his face to the ground.
verses.1:24: And Nathan said, "My lord, O king, have you said, 'Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne'?
verses.1:25: For he has gone down today, and has sacrificed calves and lambs and sheep in abundance, and has invited all the sons of the king, and the commanders of the army, and Abiathar the priest; and behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and they have said, 'Long live King Adonijah!'
verses.1:26: But me, even me your servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Solomon your servant he did not invite.
verses.1:27: Has this thing been done through my lord the king, and have you not made known to your servant who shall sit upon the throne of my lord the king after him?"
verses.1:28: Then David answered and said, "Call Bathsheba to me." And she came in before the king and stood before him.
verses.1:29: And the king swore and said, "As the Lord lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all distress,
verses.1:30: even as I swore to you by the Lord, the God of Israel, saying, 'Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my place,' surely so I will do this very day."
verses.1:31: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the ground, and did obeisance to the king, and said, "May my lord King David live forever!"
verses.1:32: And King David said, "Call to me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada." So they came in before the king.
verses.1:33: And the king said to them, "Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause my son Solomon to ride upon my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon;
verses.1:34: and anoint him there—Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet—as king over Israel, and sound the horn and say, 'Long live King Solomon!'
verses.1:35: And he shall sit upon my throne and reign in my place, and I have commanded him to be ruler over Israel and Judah."
verses.1:36: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king and said, "So be it! Thus may the God of my lord the king confirm it.
verses.1:37: As the Lord was with my lord the king, so may He be with Solomon, and may He magnify his throne above the throne of my lord King David."
verses.1:38: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down, and set Solomon upon King David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.1:39: And Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the tabernacle and anointed Solomon, and he sounded the horn; and all the people said, "Long live King Solomon!"
verses.1:40: And all the people went up after him, and they danced in dances and rejoiced with great gladness, and the earth was split by their sound.
verses.1:41: And Adonijah and all his guests heard it as they finished eating; and Joab heard the sound of the horn and said, "What is the sound of the city resounding?"
verses.1:42: While he was still speaking, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came in; and Adonijah said, "Come in, for you are a man of valor, and bring good tidings."
verses.1:43: And Jonathan answered and said, "Truly, our lord King David has made Solomon king;
verses.1:44: and the king has sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and they have set him upon the king's mule;
verses.1:45: and Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him in Gihon, and they have gone up from there rejoicing, and the city resounded; this is the sound which you have heard.
verses.1:46: Moreover, Solomon has sat upon the throne of the kingdom,
verses.1:47: and the servants of the king went in to bless our lord King David, saying, 'May God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and magnify his throne above your throne.' And the king bowed in worship upon the bed;
verses.1:48: and thus also the king said, 'Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who has given today one from my seed sitting upon my throne, while my eyes behold it.'"
verses.1:49: Then all the guests of Adonijah rose up, and went, every man to his own way.
verses.1:50: And Adonijah was afraid before Solomon; and he arose, and went away, and took hold of the horns of the altar.
verses.1:51: And it was told to Solomon, saying, "Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon, and he holds fast to the horns of the altar, saying, 'Let King Solomon swear to me today that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.'"
verses.1:52: And Solomon said, "If he proves to be a son of valor, not one of his hairs shall fall to the ground; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall be put to death."
verses.1:53: So King Solomon sent and brought him down from upon the altar; and he came in and did obeisance to King Solomon, and Solomon said to him, "Go to your house."
verses.2:1: Now the days of David drew near that he should die, and he addressed Solomon his son, saying,
verses.2:2: "I am going the way of all the earth; and you shall be strong, and become a man,
verses.2:3: and you shall keep the charge of your God, to walk in His ways, to observe His commandments, and the ordinances, and the judgments written in the law of Moses, that you may understand what you shall do according to all that I command you;
verses.2:4: that the Lord may establish His word which He spoke, saying, 'If your sons guard their way, to walk before Me in truth with all their heart,' saying, 'There shall not be cut off from you a man from upon the throne of Israel.'
verses.2:5: Moreover, you also know all that Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, all that he did to the two commanders of the hosts of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether, and he slew them, and put the blood of war upon his belt that was around his waist and upon his sandal that was on his foot.
verses.2:6: And you shall do according to your wisdom, and you shall bring down his gray hair in peace to Hades.
verses.2:7: But to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite you shall show mercy, and they shall be among those who eat at your table; for so they drew near to me when I fled from the presence of Absalom your brother.
verses.2:8: And behold, with you is Shimei the son of Gera, a son of the Jeminite, from Bahurim; and he cursed me with a grievous curse on the day that I went to the camps, yet he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by the Lord, saying, 'I will not put you to death with the sword.'
verses.2:9: And you shall by no means hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man, and you will know what you shall do to him; and you shall bring down his gray hair with blood to Hades."
verses.2:10: And David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
verses.2:11: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years; in Hebron he reigned seven years, and in Jerusalem thirty-three years.
verses.2:12: Then Solomon sat upon the throne of David his father, and his kingdom was exceedingly established.
verses.2:13: And Adonijah came in to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon and bowed down to her. And she said, "Is your coming in peace?" And he said, "In peace.
verses.2:14: I have a word for you." And she said to him, "Speak."
verses.2:15: And he said to her, "You know that the kingdom was mine, and all Israel set their face toward me to be king; yet the kingdom turned about and became my brother's, for it came to him from the Lord.
verses.2:16: And now I ask one petition of you; do not turn away your face." And Bathsheba said to him, "Speak."
verses.2:17: And he said to her, "Speak, I pray, to Solomon the king, for he will not turn away his face from you, and he will give me Abishag the Shunammite as a wife."
verses.2:18: And Bathsheba said, "Very well, I will speak for you to the king."
verses.2:19: So Bathsheba went in to King Solomon to speak to him on behalf of Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her and kissed her, and sat down upon the throne; and a throne was set for the mother of the king, and she sat at his right hand.
verses.2:20: And she said to him, "I ask one small petition of you; do not turn away your face." And the king said to her, "Ask, my mother, and I will not turn you away."
verses.2:21: And she said, "Let Abishag the Shunammite be given, I pray, to Adonijah your brother as a wife."
verses.2:22: And King Solomon answered and said to his mother, "And why have you asked for Abishag for Adonijah? Ask the kingdom for him also; for he is my brother who is older than I, and with him is Abiathar the priest, and with him is Joab the son of Zeruiah, the commander of the host, as his companion."
verses.2:23: Then King Solomon swore by the Lord, saying, "May God do so to me, and more also, for Adonijah has spoken this word against his own life.
verses.2:24: And now, as the Lord lives, who has established me and set me upon the throne of David my father, and He Himself has made me a house just as the Lord spoke, surely today Adonijah shall be put to death."
verses.2:25: So King Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and he slew him, and Adonijah died on that day.
verses.2:26: And to Abiathar the priest the king said, "Depart to Anathoth, to your field, for you are a man of death on this day; yet I will not put you to death, because you bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord before my father, and because you were afflicted in all things in which my father was afflicted."
verses.2:27: So Solomon cast out Abiathar from being a priest of the Lord, that the word of the Lord might be fulfilled which He spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.2:28: Now the report came to Joab the son of Zeruiah, for Joab had turned aside after Adonijah, though he had not turned aside after Absalom. And Joab fled to the tabernacle of the Lord and laid hold of the horns of the altar.
verses.2:29: And it was told to Solomon, saying, "Joab has fled to the tent of the Lord, and behold, he is holding fast to the horns of the altar." And Solomon sent to Joab, saying, "What has happened to you, that you have fled to the altar?" And Joab said, "Because I was afraid of your presence, and I fled to the Lord." Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, "Go and slay him, and bury him."
verses.2:30: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada came to the tent of the Lord and said to him, "Thus says the king, 'Come out.'" And Joab said, "I will not come out, for here I will die." Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada returned and spoke to the king, saying, "Thus Joab has spoken, and thus he has answered me."
verses.2:31: And the king said to him, "Go and do to him just as he has said, and slay him and bury him; and today you shall remove from me and from the house of my father the blood which he shed without cause.
verses.2:32: And the Lord has returned the blood of his unrighteousness upon his own head; and he fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, while my father David did not know of their blood: Abner the son of Ner, commander of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, commander of the host of Judah.
verses.2:33: And his blood has returned upon his own head and upon the head of his seed forever; but to David, and to his seed, and to his house, and to his throne, may there be peace forever from the Lord."
verses.2:34: And Jehoiada fell upon Joab and put him to death; and he buried him in his own house in the wilderness.
verses.2:35: And the king appointed Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his place over the army; and the kingdom was established in Jerusalem. And Zadok the priest, the king appointed him as first priest in place of Abiathar. And the Lord gave Solomon understanding and exceedingly great wisdom, and breadth of heart like the sand that is beside the sea. And the understanding of Solomon was multiplied above all the ancient sons and beyond all the men of understanding of Egypt. And he took the daughter of Pharaoh and brought her into the city of David until he finished the house of the Lord first and the wall of Jerusalem all around; in seven years he made and finished it. And Solomon had seventy thousand bearing burdens and eighty thousand stonecutters in the mountain. And Solomon made the sea, and the supports, and the great lavers, and the pillars, and the fountain of the court, and the bronze sea. And he built the citadel as a bulwark upon it; he cut through the city of David. Thus the daughter of Pharaoh went up from the city of David into her house which he had built for her; then he built the citadel. And Solomon offered up three times in the year burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he had built to the Lord, and he burned incense before the Lord. And he finished the house. And these were the rulers appointed over the works of Solomon: three thousand six hundred overseers of the people who performed the works. And he built Assur, and Magao, and Gezer, and Upper Beth-horon, and Baalath; yet after he built the house of the Lord and the wall of Jerusalem all around, after these things he built these cities. And while David was still alive, he commanded Solomon, saying, "Behold, with you is Shimei the son of Gera, a son of the seed of the Jeminite from Hebron. This man cursed me with a grievous curse on the day on which I went to the camps; yet he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by the Lord, saying, 'He shall not be put to death with the sword.' And now do not hold him guiltless, for you are a man of understanding, and you will know what you shall do to him; and you shall bring down his gray hair with blood to Hades."
verses.2:36: Then the king summoned Shimei and said to him, "Build a house for yourself in Jerusalem and dwell there, and you shall not go out from there anywhere.
verses.2:37: And it shall be, on the day of your going out and when you cross the brook Kidron, know for certain that you shall surely die; your blood shall be upon your own head." And the king made him swear an oath on that day.
verses.2:38: And Shimei said to the king, "The word that you have spoken is good, my lord the king; so your servant will do." And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem three years.
verses.2:39: And it came to pass after the three years that two servants of Shimei fled to Achish the son of Amesa, king of Gath. And it was told to Shimei, saying, "Behold, your servants are in Gath."
verses.2:40: So Shimei arose and saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish to seek out his servants; and Shimei went and brought his servants from Gath.
verses.2:41: And it was told to Solomon, saying, "Shimei has gone from Jerusalem to Gath and has brought back his servants."
verses.2:42: Then the king sent and summoned Shimei, and said to him, "Did I not make you swear by the Lord and solemnly testify to you, saying, 'On whatever day you go out from Jerusalem and go to the right or to the left, know for certain that you shall surely die'?
verses.2:43: Why then have you not kept the oath of the Lord and the commandment which I commanded concerning you?"
verses.2:44: And the king said to Shimei, "You know all your wickedness which your heart knows, the things which you did to David my father; and the Lord has repaid your wickedness upon your own head.
verses.2:45: And King Solomon is blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the Lord forever."
verses.2:46: So King Solomon commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and he went out and slew him. And King Solomon was exceedingly prudent and wise; and Judah and Israel were exceedingly many, like the sand that is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and rejoicing. And Solomon was ruler over all the kingdoms, and they brought gifts and served Solomon all the days of his life. And Solomon began to open the dominions of Lebanon; and he built Thermai in the wilderness. And this was the meal for Solomon: thirty kors of fine flour and sixty kors of pounded meal, ten choice calves and twenty pasture-fed oxen and one hundred sheep, besides deer, and gazelles, and choice pasture-fed fowl. Was he not ruler over all beyond the River, from Raphi to Gaza, over all the kings beyond the River? And he had peace on all sides around him. And Judah and Israel dwelt in confidence, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, eating and drinking, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon. And these were the rulers of Solomon: Azariah the son of Zadok the priest; and Orniou the son of Nathan, chief of the officers, and he ran to his house; and Suba the scribe; and Baasha the son of Achithalam, the recorder; and Abi the son of Joab, commander of the host; and Achire the son of Edrai, over the levies; and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, over the palace stewardship and over the brickworks; and Kachur the son of Nathan, the counselor. And Solomon had forty thousand brood mares for chariots, and twelve thousand horses; and he was ruler over all the kings from the River even to the land of the foreigners and to the borders of Egypt. Solomon the son of David reigned over Israel and Judah in Jerusalem.
verses.3:2: They were burning incense on the high places, because a house had not been built for the Lord until now.
verses.3:3: And Solomon loved the Lord, walking in the statutes of David his father; only he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
verses.3:4: And he arose and went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for it was the highest and a great high place; Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings upon the altar in Gibeon.
verses.3:5: And the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and the Lord said to Solomon, "Ask a request for yourself."
verses.3:6: And Solomon said, "You have shown great mercy toward Your servant David my father, according as he walked before You in truth and in righteousness and in uprightness of heart with You; and You have kept for him this great mercy, to set his son upon his throne, as it is this day.
verses.3:7: And now, O Lord my God, You have given Your servant in place of David my father; and I am a little child, and I do not know my going out and my coming in.
verses.3:8: And Your servant is in the midst of Your people whom You have chosen, a great people who shall not be numbered.
verses.3:9: And give to Your servant a heart to hear and to judge Your people in righteousness, and to discern between good and evil; for who shall be able to judge this weighty people of Yours?"
verses.3:10: And it was pleasing in the sight of the Lord that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.3:11: And the Lord said to him, "Because you have asked this thing from Me, and have not asked for yourself many days, and have not asked for riches, nor have you asked for the lives of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to hear judgment,
verses.3:12: behold, I have performed your word; behold, I have given you a discerning and wise heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, and after you none shall arise like you.
verses.3:13: And I have also given you what you did not ask, both riches and glory, so that there has not been a man like you among the kings;
verses.3:14: and if you walk in My way to keep My commandments and My statutes, as David your father walked, then I will multiply your days."
verses.3:15: And Solomon awoke, and behold, it was a dream. And he arose and came to Jerusalem, and stood before the altar that was before the ark of the covenant of the Lord in Zion; and he offered burnt offerings and made peace offerings, and he prepared a great banquet for himself and for all his servants.
verses.3:16: Then two women who were harlots appeared to the king and stood before him.
verses.3:17: And the one woman said, "O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house, and we gave birth in the house.
verses.3:18: And it came to pass on the third day after I gave birth, that this woman also gave birth; and we were together, and there is no one with us except the two of us in the house.
verses.3:19: And this woman's son died in the night, because she lay upon him;
verses.3:20: and she arose in the middle of the night and took my son from my arms and laid him in her bosom, and her dead son she laid in my bosom.
verses.3:21: And I arose in the morning to nurse my son, and he was dead; and behold, I examined him in the morning, and behold, he was not my son whom I had borne."
verses.3:22: And the other woman said, "No; rather, my son is the living one, and your son is the dead one." And they spoke before the king.
verses.3:23: And the king said to them, "You say, 'This is my son, the living one, and the son of this woman is the dead one'; and you say, 'No; rather, my son is the living one, and your son is the dead one.'"
verses.3:24: And the king said, "Fetch a sword." And they brought the sword before the king.
verses.3:25: And the king said, "Divide the living nursing child in two, and give half of him to this one and half of him to that one."
verses.3:26: Then the woman whose son was the living one answered and spoke to the king, for her womb was stirred over her son, and she said, "O my lord, give her the child, and by no means put him to death!" But the other said, "Let him be neither mine nor hers; divide him."
verses.3:27: And the king answered and said, "Give the child to her who said, 'Give him to her, and by no means put him to death'; she is his mother."
verses.3:28: And all Israel heard of this judgment which the king had judged; and they feared before the face of the king, for they saw that the discernment of God was in him to execute justice.
verses.4:1: And King Solomon was reigning over Israel.
verses.4:2: And these were the officials whom he had: Azari the son of Zadok,
verses.4:3: and Eliaph and Ahijah the son of Saba were scribes, and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahiliad was recorder,
verses.4:4: and Zadok and Abiathar were priests,
verses.4:5: and Ornia the son of Nathan was over the appointed officers, and Zabud the son of Nathan was the king's friend,
verses.4:6: and Ahi was steward, and Eliak was the steward, and Eliab the son of Saph was over the family, and Adoniram the son of Ephra was over the tribute.
verses.4:7: And Solomon had twelve appointed officers over all Israel, to provide for the king and his household; it fell to each one to provide for a month in the year.
verses.4:8: And these were their names: Baior in the hill country of Ephraim, one;
verses.4:9: the son of Rechas in Machemas and Bethalami and Beth-shemesh and Elom as far as Bethlaman, one;
verses.4:10: the son of Hesoth, Bernemalusamencha and Respharachein;
verses.4:11: throughout Dan and throughout Phathei, the husband of Tablethei—a daughter of Solomon was his wife—one;
verses.4:12: Bakcha the son of Ahimach: Polamach and Megiddo, and all the house of Dan which is beside Sesathan below Esrae, and from Baisaphut, Ebelmaola, as far as Maeber Lukam, one;
verses.4:13: the son of Geber, Ramoth-gilead—to him belonged the region of Eretabam in Bashan, sixty great walled cities with bars of bronze—one;
verses.4:14: Ahinaab the son of Achel, Mahanaim;
verses.4:15: Ahimaaz in Naphtali—he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon—one;
verses.4:16: Baana the son of Hushai in Maala, one;
verses.4:17: the son of Elah in Benjamin;
verses.4:18: the son of Adai in the land of Gad, the land of Sihon king of Heshbon and of Og king of Bashan; and one naseph in the land of Judah;
verses.4:19: Jehoshaphat the son of Phuasud in Issachar.
verses.5:1: And the appointed officers thus provided for King Solomon, and all the prescribed provisions for the table of the king, each in his month; they do not deviate from a single word. And the barley and the straw for the horses and for the chariots they carried to the place wherever the king might be, each according to his appointed order.
verses.5:2: And these were the required provisions for Solomon in one day: thirty kors of fine flour and sixty kors of pounded meal,
verses.5:3: and ten choice calves, and twenty pasture-fed oxen, and one hundred sheep, besides deer and gazelles and choice fattened fowl.
verses.5:4: For he was ruler beyond the River, and he had peace from all sides round about.
verses.5:9: And the Lord gave Solomon understanding and exceedingly great wisdom, and an outpouring of heart like the sand that is beside the sea.
verses.5:10: And Solomon was increased exceedingly above the understanding of all ancient men and above all the discerning men of Egypt.
verses.5:11: And he was wiser than all men; and he was wiser than Gaithan the Zareite, and Ainan, and Chalkad, and Darala, the son of Mal.
verses.5:12: And Solomon spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs were five thousand.
verses.5:13: And he spoke concerning the trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that comes forth through the wall; and he spoke concerning the beasts, and concerning the birds, and concerning the creeping things, and concerning the fish.
verses.5:14: And Solomon built Gezer. And all the peoples came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and from all the kings of the earth, as many as heard of his wisdom. And Solomon took the daughter of Pharaoh for himself as a wife, and brought her into the city of David until he finished the house of the Lord, and his own house, and the wall of Jerusalem. When Pharaoh king of Egypt went up, he seized Gezer and burned it, and the Canaanite dwelling in Mergab, and Pharaoh gave them as a dowry to his daughter, the wife of Solomon.
verses.5:15: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to anoint Solomon in place of David his father, for Hiram had loved David all the days.
verses.5:16: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
verses.5:17: "You know David my father, that he was not able to build a house for the name of the Lord my God because of the wars that surrounded him, until He put them under the soles of his feet.
verses.5:18: And now the Lord my God has given me rest on every side; there is no adversary and there is no evil mishap.
verses.5:19: And behold, I say, 'I will build a house for the name of the Lord my God,' just as the Lord God spoke to David my father, saying, 'Your son, whom I will set in your place upon your throne, he shall build the house for My name.'
verses.5:20: And now give command, and let them cut timber for me from Lebanon; and behold, my servants will be with your servants, and for your service I will give to you according to all that you may say; for you know that we do not have the skill of ourselves to cut timber like the Sidonians."
verses.5:21: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced exceedingly and said, "Blessed be God this day, who has given to David a discerning son over this great people."
verses.5:22: And he sent to Solomon, saying, "I have heard concerning all the things that you have sent to me; I will do all your desire, both timber of cedar and of pine.
verses.5:23: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon to the sea; I will form them into rafts as far as the place of which you send word to me, and I will break them apart there, and you shall take them away; and you shall do my desire in giving bread to my household."
verses.5:24: And Hiram continually gave Solomon cedars and all his desire.
verses.5:25: And Solomon gave to Hiram twenty thousand kors of wheat and macheir for his household, and twenty thousand baths of beaten oil; thus Solomon gave to Hiram year by year.
verses.5:26: And the Lord gave wisdom to Solomon, just as He had spoken to him; and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and they made a covenant between themselves.
verses.5:27: And the king raised a levy even from all Israel, and the levy was thirty thousand men.
verses.5:28: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month in shifts; one month they were in Lebanon and two months at their own home; and Adoniram was over the levy.
verses.5:29: And Solomon had seventy thousand bearers of burdens and eighty thousand stonecutters in the mountain,
verses.5:30: besides the chief officers who were appointed over the works of Solomon, three thousand six hundred overseers who carried out the works.
verses.5:32: And they prepared the stones and the timbers for three years.
verses.6:1: And it came to pass in the four hundred and fortieth year of the departure of the sons of Israel from Egypt, in the fourth year, in the second month of the reign of King Solomon over Israel, that they brought great, costly stones for the foundation of the house, and unhewn stones; and the sons of Solomon and the sons of Hiram hewed them and laid them. In the fourth year he laid the foundation of the house of the Lord, in the month of Neiso and the second month. In the eleventh year, in the month of Baad, which is the eighth month, the house was finished according to every specification of it and according to every arrangement of it.
verses.6:2: And as for the house which the king built for the Lord, its length was forty cubits, and its width twenty cubits, and its height twenty-five cubits.
verses.6:3: And the vestibule before the temple was twenty cubits in its length according to the width of the house, before the house. And he built the house and finished it.
verses.6:4: And he made for the house recessed, hidden windows.
verses.6:5: And against the wall of the house itself he placed chambers round about, for both the temple and the inner sanctuary.
verses.6:6: The lowest side story was five cubits in its width, and the middle one six, and the third was seven cubits in its width; for he provided a setback for the house round about on the outside of the house, so that they should not take hold of the walls of the house.
verses.6:7: And the house, while it was being built, was built with quarried, unworked stones; and neither hammer nor axe nor any iron tool was heard in the house while it was being built.
verses.6:8: And the doorway of the lowest side story was beneath the right shoulder of the house, and there was a winding ascent to the middle story, and from the middle to the third story.
verses.6:9: And he built the house and finished it; and he paneled the house with cedars.
verses.6:10: And he built the framework throughout the whole house, five cubits in its height, and he bound the structure together with cedar timbers.
verses.6:15: And he built the walls of the house with cedar timbers, from the floor of the house even to the beams and even to the walls; he paneled it continuously with wood on the inside, and he covered the interior of the house with planks of pine.
verses.6:16: And he built the twenty cubits from the end of the wall, the one side from the floor to the beams; and he made it out of the inner sanctuary for the Holy of Holies.
verses.6:17: And the temple was forty cubits before the inner sanctuary, in the midst of the house within, to place there the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.6:19: To place there the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.6:20: Twenty cubits was its length, and twenty cubits its width, and twenty cubits its height.
verses.6:21: And he overlaid it with sealed gold; and he made an altar before the inner sanctuary and overlaid it with gold.
verses.6:22: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until the completion of all the house.
verses.6:23: And he made in the inner sanctuary two cherubim, ten cubits in measured stature.
verses.6:24: And its wing was five cubits; and the second was ten cubits from the tip of its wing.
verses.6:25: Likewise for the second cherub: of one measure and one form; both had one form.
verses.6:26: And the height of the cherub was by the cubit, and likewise the second cherub.
verses.6:27: And both cherubim were in the midst of the innermost house; and he spread out their wings, and one wing touched the wall, and a wing touched the second wall; and their wings that were in the midst of the house touched wing to wing.
verses.6:28: And he overlaid the cherubim with gold.
verses.6:29: Upon all the walls of the house round about he engraved with a graving tool carved figures of cherubim, and palm trees, both for the inner and for the outer.
verses.6:30: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, both of the innermost and of the outermost.
verses.6:31: And for the doorway of the inner sanctuary he made doors of juniper wood, with pillars fourfold.
verses.6:34: In both doors was pine wood: two leaves were the one door, with their pivots, and two leaves the second door, pivoting.
verses.6:35: Carved upon them were cherubim and palm trees and spread-out blossoms, and they were overlaid with gold laid down upon the carved work.
verses.6:36: And he built the innermost court: three courses of unhewn stones, and a course of dressed cedar round about. And he built a curtain for the court of the vestibule of the house that was before the temple.
verses.7:1: And King Solomon sent and brought Hiram from Tyre,
verses.7:2: the son of a widow woman, and he was from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a craftsman in bronze, filled with skill and understanding and knowledge to perform every work in bronze; and he was brought to King Solomon, and he made all the works.
verses.7:3: And he cast the porch of the house: eighteen cubits was the height of the pillar, and a circumference of fourteen cubits encircled it; the thickness of the pillar was four fingers, its hollow interior; and thus was the second pillar.
verses.7:4: And he made two cast capitals to place upon the heads of the pillars; five cubits was the height of the one capital.
verses.7:5: And he made two networks to cover the capital of the pillars, even a network for the one capital and a network for the second capital.
verses.7:6: And hanging work, two rows of bronze pomegranates set in network, hanging work, row upon row; and thus he made for the second capital.
verses.7:7: And he set up the pillars of the porch of the temple; and he set up the one pillar and called its name Jachum, and he set up the second pillar and called its name Balaz.
verses.7:8: And upon the heads of the pillars was lily work by the porch, of four cubits.
verses.7:9: And there was a beam upon both of the pillars, and above the sides was a capital, the beam, of a cubit.
verses.7:10: And he made the sea ten cubits from its wall to its brim, round all about, and five cubits was its height, and gathered around it measured thirty-three cubits.
verses.7:11: And supports beneath its brim all around encircled it, ten in a cubit all around.
verses.7:12: And its brim was like the workmanship of the brim of a cup, the blossom of a lily, and its thickness was a handbreadth.
verses.7:13: And twelve oxen were beneath the sea: three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and all their hinder parts were toward the house, and the sea was above upon them.
verses.7:14: And he made ten bronze bases: five cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits its width, and six cubits its height.
verses.7:15: And this was the workmanship of the bases: they had an enclosed border, and an enclosed border between the projecting ledges.
verses.7:16: And upon their enclosed panels between the projecting ledges were lions and oxen and cherubim; and upon the projecting ledges likewise above; and beneath the lions and the oxen were spaces, descending work.
verses.7:17: And each base had four bronze wheels, and bronze axle supports; and their four corners had shoulder supports beneath the lavers.
verses.7:18: And there were stays on the wheels in the base; and the height of one wheel was a cubit and a half.
verses.7:19: And the workmanship of the wheels was the workmanship of chariot wheels; their stays and their rims and their entire structure were all cast.
verses.7:20: The four shoulder supports were upon the four corners of each base; out of the base itself came its shoulders;
verses.7:21: and on the top of the base its measure was half a cubit, round all about on the top of the base, along with the head of its stays and its enclosed panels; and it opened upon the four heads of its stays.
verses.7:22: And its enclosed panels had cherubim and lions and palm trees standing, each adjoining the other facing inward and all around.
verses.7:23: According to this he made all the ten bases, one order and one measure for them all.
verses.7:24: And he made ten bronze lavers, each laver holding forty choes by measure; one laver was upon one base for the ten bases.
verses.7:25: And he placed the five bases on the left side of the house; and the sea was on the right side of the house toward the east, from the quarter of the south.
verses.7:26: And Hiram made the cauldrons and the firepans and the bowls; and Hiram finished doing all the works that he made for King Solomon in the house of the Lord:
verses.7:27: two pillars, and the two wreathed ornaments of the pillars upon the heads of the pillars; and the two networks to cover both wreathed ornaments of the carvings that were upon the pillars;
verses.7:28: the four hundred pomegranates for both networks, two rows of pomegranates for the one network to cover both wreathed ornaments of the base that were upon both pillars;
verses.7:29: and the ten bases, and the ten lavers upon the bases;
verses.7:30: and the one sea, and the twelve oxen beneath the sea;
verses.7:31: and the cauldrons and the firepans and the bowls and all the vessels that Hiram made for King Solomon for the house of the Lord; and the forty-eight pillars of the house of the king and of the house of the Lord; all the works of the king Hiram made wholly of bronze.
verses.7:32: There was no weighing of the bronze from which he made all these works, because of its exceedingly great abundance; there was no end to the weight of the bronze.
verses.7:33: In the region around the Jordan he cast them, in the thick earth between Succoth and Seira.
verses.7:34: And King Solomon took the vessels that he had made in the house: the golden altar, and the golden table upon which were the loaves of the offering,
verses.7:35: and the lampstands—five on the left and five on the right before the inner sanctuary—of solid gold, and the lamp holders and the lamps and the oil pourers of gold;
verses.7:36: and the thresholds and the nails and the bowls and the dishes and the censers, of solid gold; and the doorframes of the doors of the innermost house, the Holy of Holies, and the doors of the temple, of gold.
verses.7:37: And the work that Solomon made for the house of the Lord was completed; and Solomon brought in the holy things of David his father and all the holy things of Solomon; the silver and the gold he placed into the treasuries of the house of the Lord.
verses.7:38: And Solomon built his own house for thirteen years.
verses.7:39: And he built the house of the Forest of Lebanon: one hundred cubits was its length, and fifty cubits its width; and it was of three rows of cedar pillars, and there were cedar shoulder beams upon the pillars.
verses.7:40: And he paneled the house above upon the sides of the pillars; and the number of the pillars was forty-five in the row,
verses.7:41: and there were three beams, and space opposite space in three tiers.
verses.7:42: And all the doorways and the spaces were squared and framed with beams, and from doorway to door in three tiers.
verses.7:43: And the porch of the pillars was fifty in length and fifty in width, joined together, with a porch in front of them, and pillars and a thick beam in front of it for the porches.
verses.7:44: And the porch of the thrones, where he will judge there, was the porch of judgment.
verses.7:45: And their house—in a house he will dwell there—had one court winding out from these according to this workmanship; and a house for the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Solomon had taken, according to this porch.
verses.7:46: All these were of costly stones, hewn at intervals on the inside, and from the foundation to the cornices, and on the outside toward the great court,
verses.7:47: which was founded with great costly stones, stones of ten cubits and of eight cubits;
verses.7:48: and above with costly stones according to the measure of unhewn stones, and with cedars.
verses.7:49: The circuits of the great court were three rows of unhewn stones and a row of joined cedar.
verses.7:50: And Solomon finished his entire house.
verses.8:1: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished building the house of the Lord and his own house after twenty years, then King Solomon assembled all the elders of Israel in Zion to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion,
verses.8:3: And the priests took up the ark,
verses.8:4: and the tabernacle of testimony, and the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.8:5: And the king and all Israel were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen without number.
verses.8:6: And the priests brought the ark into its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, into the Holy of Holies, beneath the wings of the cherubim.
verses.8:7: For the cherubim had their wings spread out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered over the ark and over its holy things from above.
verses.8:8: And the consecrated things extended beyond, and the ends of the consecrated things were seen from the holy place before the inner sanctuary, yet they were not seen outside.
verses.8:9: There was nothing in the ark except two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant which Moses placed at Horeb, which the Lord made with the sons of Israel when they came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.8:10: And it came to pass, when the priests came out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house.
verses.8:11: And the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled the house.
verses.8:14: Then the king turned his face around, and the king blessed all Israel, while the whole assembly of Israel stood.
verses.8:15: And he said, "Blessed be the Lord God of Israel today, who spoke with His mouth concerning David my father, and with His hands has fulfilled it, saying,
verses.8:16: 'From the day that I brought My people Israel out of Egypt, I did not choose a city from any one tribe of Israel to build a house, that My name might be there; yet I chose Jerusalem for My name to abide there, and I chose David to be over My people Israel.'
verses.8:17: And it was in the heart of my father to build a house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.8:18: And the Lord said to David my father, 'Because it came into your heart to build a house for My name, you did well that it was in your heart.
verses.8:19: You shall not build the house; rather, your son who comes forth from your loins—he shall build the house for My name.'
verses.8:20: And the Lord has established His word which He spoke; and I have risen in the place of David my father, and have sat upon the throne of Israel, just as He spoke, and have built the house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.8:21: And there I have appointed a place for the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord which the Lord made with our fathers when He brought them out of the land of Egypt."
verses.8:22: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of the whole assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven,
verses.8:23: and said, "Lord God of Israel, there is no God like You in heaven above and on the earth beneath, who keeps covenant and mercy for Your servant who walks before You with all his heart,
verses.8:24: which You have kept for Your servant David my father; for indeed You spoke with Your mouth, and with Your hands You have fulfilled it, as it is this day.
verses.8:25: And now, Lord God of Israel, keep for Your servant David my father what You spoke to him, saying, 'A man of yours shall not be cut off from before Me sitting upon the throne of Israel, if only your children guard their ways to walk before Me just as you walked before Me.'
verses.8:26: And now, Lord God of Israel, let Your word be confirmed, I pray, to David my father.
verses.8:27: For will God indeed dwell with men upon the earth? If heaven and the heaven of heaven will not suffice for You, how much less this house which I have built for Your name?
verses.8:28: Yet look upon my supplication, Lord God of Israel, to hear the delight which Your servant prays before You, to You today,
verses.8:29: that Your eyes may be open toward this house day and night, toward the place of which You said, 'My name shall be there,' to hear the prayer which Your servant prays toward this place day and night.
verses.8:30: And hear the supplication of Your servant and of Your people Israel, whatever they pray toward this place; and hear in the place of Your dwelling in heaven, and act, and be merciful.
verses.8:31: In whatever way anyone sins against his neighbor, and if one lays upon him a curse to cause him to swear, and he comes and makes confession before Your altar in this house,
verses.8:32: then hear from heaven and act, and judge Your people Israel, condemning the lawless, bringing his way upon his own head, and justifying the righteous, giving to him according to his righteousness.
verses.8:33: When Your people Israel fall before enemies because they sin against You, and they turn back and confess Your name, and pray and make supplication in this house,
verses.8:34: then hear from heaven and be merciful to the sins of Your servant Israel, and bring them back to the land which You gave to their fathers.
verses.8:35: When heaven is shut up and there is no rain because they sin against You, and they pray toward this place and confess Your name, and turn from their sins when You humble them,
verses.8:36: then hear from heaven, and be merciful to the sins of Your servant and of Your people Israel, for You will show them the good way to walk in it, and give rain upon the land which You gave to Your servant for an inheritance.
verses.8:37: If there is famine, if there is pestilence, when there is scorching heat, if there is locust or mildew, and if his enemy afflicts him in one of his cities, whatever calamity, whatever distress,
verses.8:38: whatever prayer, whatever supplication is made by any man when each one knows the plague of his own heart, and spreads out his hands toward this house,
verses.8:39: then hear from heaven, from Your prepared dwelling place, and be merciful, and act, and render to each man according to his ways, just as You know his heart, for You alone know the heart of all the sons of men,
verses.8:40: that they may fear You all the days that they live upon the land which You gave to our fathers.
verses.8:41: And also concerning the foreigner who is not of Your people,
verses.8:42: when they come and pray toward this place,
verses.8:43: then hear from heaven, from Your prepared dwelling place, and act according to all for which the foreigner calls upon You, that all the peoples may know Your name and fear You, just as Your people Israel do, and may know that Your name has been called upon this house which I have built.
verses.8:44: When Your people go out to war against their enemies by the way in which You turn them, and they pray in the name of the Lord toward the city which You have chosen and the house which I have built for Your name,
verses.8:45: then hear from heaven their supplication and their prayer, and execute justice for them.
verses.8:46: When they sin against You—for there is no man who will not sin—and You bring them and deliver them before enemies, and their captors carry them away captive to a land far and near,
verses.8:47: and they turn their hearts in the land to which they were carried away, and they repent in the land of their exile and make supplication to You, saying, 'We have sinned, we have acted unjustly, we have committed lawlessness,'
verses.8:48: and they return to You with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies to which You carried them away, and they pray to You toward their land which You gave to their fathers, toward the city which You have chosen, and the house which I have built for Your name,
verses.8:49: then hear from heaven, from Your prepared dwelling place,
verses.8:50: and be merciful to their iniquities by which they have sinned against You, and for all their transgressions by which they have transgressed against You, and grant them compassion before those who hold them captive, that they may have compassion on them;
verses.8:51: for they are Your people and Your inheritance, whom You brought out of the land of Egypt, from the midst of the iron furnace.
verses.8:52: And let Your eyes and Your ears be open to the supplication of Your servant and to the supplication of Your people Israel, to hear them in all things for which they call upon You.
verses.8:53: And You set them apart for Yourself as an inheritance from among all the peoples of the earth, just as You spoke by the hand of Your servant Moses when You brought our fathers out of the land of Egypt, O Lord, Lord." Then Solomon spoke concerning the house when he had finished building it: "The Lord has made known the sun in heaven; He said He would dwell out of thick darkness. Build my house, a splendid house for Yourself, to dwell in anew." Behold, is this not written in the Book of the Song?
verses.8:54: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to the Lord, that he arose from before the altar of the Lord, having knelt upon his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven.
verses.8:55: And he stood and blessed the whole assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
verses.8:56: "Blessed be the Lord today, who has given rest to His people Israel, according to all that He spoke; not one word has failed among all His good words which He spoke by the hand of His servant Moses.
verses.8:57: May the Lord our God be with us, just as He was with our fathers; may He not forsake us nor turn away from us,
verses.8:58: that He may incline our hearts to Himself, to walk in all His ways, and to keep all His commandments and His ordinances which He commanded our fathers.
verses.8:59: And may these words with which I have made supplication before the Lord our God be near to the Lord our God day and night, that He may maintain the just cause of Your servant Israel, the matter of each day in its day of the year,
verses.8:60: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord God—He is God, and there is no other.
verses.8:61: And let our hearts be perfect toward the Lord our God, and to walk devoutly in His ordinances and to keep His commandments, as it is this day."
verses.8:62: And the king and all the sons of Israel offered sacrifice before the Lord.
verses.8:63: And King Solomon offered the sacrifices of peace offerings which he offered to the Lord, twenty-two thousand oxen; and the king and all the sons of Israel dedicated the house of the Lord.
verses.8:64: On that day the king consecrated the middle of the court that was in front of the house of the Lord; for there he offered the burnt offering, and the sacrifices, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before the Lord was too small to be able to bear the burnt offering and the sacrifices of the peace offerings.
verses.8:65: And Solomon observed the feast on that day, and all Israel with him, a great assembly from the entrance of Hamath to the river of Egypt, before the Lord our God in the house which he had built, eating and drinking and rejoicing before the Lord our God seven days.
verses.8:66: And on the eighth day he sent the people away, and he blessed them; and each one departed to his own tents rejoicing, and glad in heart for the good things which the Lord had done for David His servant and for Israel His people.
verses.9:1: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished building the house of the Lord and the house of the king, and all the undertaking of Solomon, all that he desired to accomplish,
verses.9:2: that the Lord appeared to Solomon a second time, just as He had appeared in Gabaoth.
verses.9:3: And the Lord said to him, "I have heard the voice of your prayer and of your supplication which you have made before Me; I have done for you according to all your prayer. I have consecrated this house which you have built, to place My name there forever; and My eyes shall be there forever, and My heart all the days.
verses.9:4: And as for you, if you walk before Me just as David your father walked, in holiness of heart and in uprightness, and to do according to all that I commanded him, and if you keep My statutes and My commandments,
verses.9:5: then I will raise up the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I spoke to David your father, saying, 'There shall not be cut off from you a man ruling in Israel.'
verses.9:6: But if you and your children indeed turn away from Me, and do not keep My commandments and My statutes which Moses set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,
verses.9:7: then I will cut off Israel from the land which I have given them, and this house which I have consecrated for My name I will cast away from My presence; and Israel shall become a desolation and a byword among all the peoples.
verses.9:8: And this house shall be the lofty one; everyone who passes through it shall be astonished and shall hiss, and they shall say, 'For what reason has the Lord done thus to this land and to this house?'
verses.9:9: And they shall say, 'Because they forsook the Lord their God, who brought their fathers out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, and laid hold of foreign gods and worshiped them and served them; therefore He has brought this calamity upon them.'" Then Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh from the city of David into his house which he had built for himself in those days.
verses.9:10: During twenty years, in which Solomon built the two houses, the house of the Lord and the house of the king,
verses.9:11: Hiram king of Tyre assisted Solomon with cedar timber and with pine timber and with gold, and with everything he desired. Then the king gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.9:12: And Hiram went out from Tyre and journeyed to Galilee to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and it did not please him.
verses.9:13: And he said, "What are these cities which you have given me, brother?" And he called them Border to this day.
verses.9:14: And Hiram brought to Solomon one hundred and twenty talents of gold.
verses.9:26: And in return for this, King Solomon built a ship in Emaeseion Gaber, which is beside Elath on the shore of the farthest sea in the land of Edom.
verses.9:27: And Hiram sent in the ship some of his servants, seafaring men who knew how to row and knew the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
verses.9:28: And they came to Sophera, and took from there one hundred and twenty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.
verses.10:1: And the queen of Sheba heard of the name of Solomon and the name of the Lord, and she came to test him with riddles.
verses.10:2: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great retinue, and camels bearing spices, and very much gold, and precious stones; and she went in to Solomon and spoke to him all that was in her heart.
verses.10:3: And Solomon declared to her all her matters; there was no matter overlooked by the king which he did not declare to her.
verses.10:4: And the queen of Sheba saw all the wisdom of Solomon, and the house which he had built,
verses.10:5: and the food of Solomon, and the seating of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and his apparel, and his cupbearers, and his burnt offering which he offered in the house of the Lord; and she was beside herself.
verses.10:6: And she said to King Solomon, "True was the report which I heard in my own land concerning your word and concerning your wisdom;
verses.10:7: yet I did not believe those who spoke to me, until I came and my own eyes saw it; and behold, they are not half as they reported to me, for you have added good things to them beyond all the report which I heard in my own land.
verses.10:8: Blessed are your wives, blessed are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear all your wisdom.
verses.10:9: May the Lord your God be blessed, who delighted in you, to place you on the throne of Israel, because the Lord loves Israel to establish it forever; and He has appointed you king over them, to execute judgment in righteousness and in their judgments."
verses.10:10: And she gave to Solomon one hundred and twenty talents of gold, and very abundant spices, and precious stones; never again came spices in such abundance as those which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
verses.10:11: And the ship of Hiram was carrying the gold from Souphir; it brought very much hewn timber and precious stones.
verses.10:12: And the king made of the hewn timber supports for the house of the Lord and for the house of the king, and harps and lyres for the singers; no such hewn timber had come into the land, nor has any been seen anywhere to this day.
verses.10:13: And King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all that she desired, whatever she asked, besides all that he had given her by the hand of King Solomon; and she turned back and went to her own land, she and all her servants.
verses.10:14: Now the weight of the gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold,
verses.10:15: besides the tributes of the subject peoples, of the merchants, and of all the kings of the region beyond, and of the satraps of the land.
verses.10:16: And Solomon made three hundred spears of beaten gold; three hundred pieces of gold went upon each spear;
verses.10:17: and three hundred shields of beaten gold; and three minas of gold went into each shield; and he placed them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.10:18: And the king made a great ivory throne, and overlaid it with refined gold.
verses.10:19: There were six steps to the throne, and busts of calves on the throne behind it, on this side and on that side upon the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests,
verses.10:20: and twelve lions standing on the six steps, on this side and on that side; nothing like it has been made in any kingdom.
verses.10:21: And all the vessels made by Solomon were of gold, and the basins were of gold; all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were encased in gold; there was no silver, for it was not esteemed in the days of Solomon.
verses.10:22: For the king had a ship of Tarshish on the sea with the ships of Hiram; once every three years a ship came to the king from Tarshish with gold and silver, and engraved and hewn stones. This was the enterprise of the levy which King Solomon raised to build the house of the Lord, and the house of the king, and the wall of Jerusalem, and the citadel, to enclose the fortification of the city of David, and Assour, and Midian, and Gezer, and Upper Baithoram, and Iethermath, and all the cities of the chariots, and all the cities of the horsemen; and the undertaking of Solomon which he undertook to build in Jerusalem and in all the land, so that none might rule over him—all the people who were pointed out from the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, who were not of the sons of Israel, their children who remained after them in the land, whom the sons of Israel were not able to utterly destroy—Solomon brought them up into tribute to this day. And from the sons of Israel Solomon imposed no task, for they were the men of war, and his servants, and commanders of his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.10:23: And Solomon was magnified above all the kings in riches and in wisdom.
verses.10:24: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom which the Lord had given to his heart.
verses.10:25: And each of them brought his gifts: vessels of gold and garments, myrrh oil and spices, and horses and mules, year by year.
verses.10:26: And Solomon had four thousand mares for chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he stationed them in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem. And he was ruler over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the borders of Egypt.
verses.10:27: And the king made gold and silver in Jerusalem like stones, and he made cedars like the sycamore trees that are in the lowland for abundance.
verses.10:28: And Solomon's supply of horsemen came from Egypt, and from Thekoue came the king's merchants, and he received them from Thekoue in exchange;
verses.10:29: and the supply came up from Egypt: a chariot for one hundred pieces of silver, and a horse for fifty pieces of silver; and thus for all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Syria they went forth by sea.
verses.11:1: Now King Solomon was a lover of women, and he had seven hundred princesses and three hundred concubines; and he took foreign wives, and the daughter of Pharaoh—Moabite, Ammonite, Syrian and Idumean, Hittite and Amorite—
verses.11:2: from the nations concerning whom the Lord had forbidden the children of Israel, saying, "You shall not go in to them, nor shall they come in to you, lest they turn your hearts aside after their idols." To these Solomon clung in love.
verses.11:4: And it came to pass in the time of Solomon's old age that his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God, as was the heart of David his father; and the foreign wives turned his heart aside after their gods.
verses.11:5: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh, the idol of Moab, and for their king, the idol of the sons of Ammon,
verses.11:6: and for Astarte, the abomination of the Sidonians.
verses.11:7: And thus he did for all his foreign wives; they burned incense and offered sacrifices to their idols.
verses.11:8: So Solomon did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not walk after the Lord as did David his father.
verses.11:9: And the Lord was angry with Solomon, because he turned his heart aside from the Lord God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,
verses.11:10: and had commanded him concerning this matter not at all to walk after other gods, and to take heed to do what the Lord God had commanded him; neither was his heart perfect with the Lord according to the heart of David his father.
verses.11:11: Therefore the Lord said to Solomon, "Because these things have been found with you, and you have not kept My commandments and My ordinances which I commanded you, I will surely tear your kingdom out of your hand and give it to your servant.
verses.11:12: Yet in your days I will not do these things, for the sake of David your father; out of the hand of your son I will take it.
verses.11:13: However, I will by no means take the whole kingdom; one tribe I will give to your son for the sake of David My servant, and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen."
verses.11:14: And the Lord raised up an adversary against Solomon: Ader the Idumean, and Esrom the son of Eliada, who was in Raemmaaer, Hadadezer king of Zobah, his lord. And men were gathered to him, and he became captain of a band and seized Damascus beforehand; and they were an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon. And Ader the Idumean was of the royal seed in Idumea.
verses.11:15: And it came to pass, when David utterly destroyed Edom, when Joab the commander of the army went to bury the slain, that they cut down every male in Idumea;
verses.11:16: for six months Joab and all Israel remained there in Idumea, until he had utterly destroyed every male in Idumea.
verses.11:17: And Ader fled, he and all the Idumeans of his father's servants with him, and they entered into Egypt; and Ader was a little lad.
verses.11:18: And men arose from the city of Midian and came to Paran, and they took men with them and came to Pharaoh king of Egypt; and Ader went in to Pharaoh, and he gave him a house and appointed bread for him.
verses.11:19: And Ader found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, and he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Thekemina the elder. And the sister of Thekemina bore to him, to Ader, Genubath her son;
verses.11:20: and Thekemina raised him in the midst of the sons of Pharaoh, and Genubath was in the midst of the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.11:21: And Ader heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the commander of the army was dead; and Ader said to Pharaoh, "Send me away, and I will return to my own land."
verses.11:22: Then Pharaoh said to Ader, "What do you lack with me, that behold, you seek to depart to your own land?" And Ader said to him, "Surely, you shall indeed send me away." And Ader returned to his own land.
verses.11:25: This is the evil which Ader did; and he loathed Israel, and reigned in Edom.
verses.11:26: Now Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the Ephrathite from Sarira, the son of a widow woman, was the servant of Solomon.
verses.11:27: And this was the matter in which he lifted up his hands against the king: Solomon built the citadel; he closed up the wall of the city of David his father.
verses.11:28: And the man Jeroboam was mighty in strength; and Solomon saw the young man, that he was an industrious man, and he set him over the levies of the house of Joseph.
verses.11:29: And it came to pass at that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that Ahijah the Shilonite, the prophet, found him on the way, and drew him aside from the way; and Ahijah was clad in a new garment, and both of them were in the field.
verses.11:30: And Ahijah took hold of his new garment that was on him, and tore it into twelve pieces;
verses.11:31: and he said to Jeroboam, "Take for yourself ten pieces, for thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: 'Behold, I am tearing the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and I will give to you ten tribes,
verses.11:32: and two tribes shall be his for the sake of David My servant, and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel,
verses.11:33: because he has forsaken Me, and has made offerings to Astarte, the abomination of the Sidonians, and to Chemosh and among the idols of Moab, and to their king, the detestable thing of the sons of Ammon, and has not walked in My ways to do what is right in My sight, as did David his father.
verses.11:34: Yet I will by no means take the whole kingdom out of his hand, for I will surely oppose him all the days of his life, for the sake of David My servant whom I chose.
verses.11:35: And I will take the kingdom out of the hand of his son, and I will give to you the ten tribes;
verses.11:36: but to his son I will give the two tribes, so that My servant David may have an established place all the days before Me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for Myself, to place My name there.
verses.11:37: And I will take you, and you shall reign over all that your soul desires, and you shall be king over Israel.
verses.11:38: And it shall be, if you keep all that I command you, and walk in My ways, and do what is right in My sight, to observe My commandments and My ordinances, as David My servant did, then I will be with you and build for you a faithful house, as I built for David.'"
verses.11:40: And Solomon sought to put Jeroboam to death; but he arose and departed and fled to Egypt, to Susakim king of Egypt, and he was in Egypt until Solomon died.
verses.11:41: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and all his understanding, behold, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
verses.11:42: And the days that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem were forty years.
verses.11:43: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David his father. And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it—while he was still in Egypt, since he had fled from the presence of Solomon and dwelt in Egypt—that he set his course directly, and he came to his own city, to the land of Sarira which is in Mount Ephraim. And King Solomon slept with his fathers, and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
verses.12:1: And King Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel were coming to Shechem to make him king.
verses.12:3: And the people spoke to King Rehoboam, saying,
verses.12:4: "Your father made our yoke heavy; now therefore, lighten the harsh servitude of your father, and his heavy yoke which he laid upon us, and we will serve you."
verses.12:5: And he said to them, "Depart for three days, and return to me." So they departed.
verses.12:6: And the king summoned the elders who had stood before Solomon his father while he was still alive, saying, "How do you advise that I answer this people a word?"
verses.12:7: And they spoke to him, saying, "If on this day you will be a servant to this people, and serve them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants all the days."
verses.12:8: But he forsook the counsel of the elders which they had counseled him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before his presence,
verses.12:9: and he said to them, "What do you advise? And what shall I answer this people who have spoken to me, saying, 'Lighten the yoke which your father laid upon us'?"
verses.12:10: And the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before his presence, spoke to him, saying, "Thus you shall speak to this people who have spoken to you, saying, 'Your father made our yoke heavy, now therefore lighten it from us'—thus you shall speak to them: 'My littleness is thicker than my father's loins.
verses.12:11: And now, whereas my father loaded you with a heavy yoke, I also will add to your yoke; my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.'"
verses.12:12: So all Israel came to King Rehoboam on the third day, just as the king had spoken to them, saying, "Return to me on the third day."
verses.12:13: And the king answered the people harshly, and Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the elders which they had counseled him,
verses.12:14: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, "My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke; my father chastised you with whips, and I will chastise you with scorpions."
verses.12:15: So the king did not listen to the people, for the turn of events was from the Lord, that He might establish His word which He had spoken by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.12:16: And all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them; and the people answered the king, saying, "What portion do we have in David? We have no inheritance in the son of Jesse! Depart, O Israel, to your tents! Now shepherd your own house, David!" So Israel departed to their tents.
verses.12:18: Then the king sent Aram, who was over the tribute, and they stoned him with stones, and he died; and King Rehoboam hastened to go up in order to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.12:19: So Israel rebelled against the house of David to this day.
verses.12:20: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Rehoboam had returned, that they sent and called him to the assembly, and made him king over Israel; and there was none following David except the tribe of Judah and Benjamin alone.
verses.12:21: And Rehoboam entered into Jerusalem, and convened the assembly of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, one hundred and twenty thousand young men who made war, to fight against the house of Israel, to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
verses.12:22: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.12:23: "Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
verses.12:24: 'Thus says the Lord: You shall not go up nor fight against your brethren, the children of Israel; let every man return to his own house, for this matter has come from Me.'" And they listened to the word of the Lord, and ceased from going, according to the word of the Lord. And King Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place in Jerusalem, being sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twelve years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Naanan, the daughter of Ana the son of Nahash, king of Ammon; and he did evil in the sight of the Lord and did not walk in the way of David his father. And there was a man from Mount Ephraim, a servant to Solomon, and his name was Jeroboam, and his mother's name was Sarisa, a harlot; and Solomon appointed him as commander of the staff over the levies of the house of Joseph. And Solomon built Sarira which is in Mount Ephraim, and he had three hundred chariots of horses; this man built the citadel by the levies of the house of Ephraim; this man enclosed the city of David, and he was lifting himself up against the kingdom. And Solomon sought to put him to death; and he was afraid and fled to Susakim king of Egypt, and was with him until Solomon died. And Jeroboam heard in Egypt that Solomon was dead, and he spoke in the ears of Susakim king of Egypt, saying, "Send me away, and I will depart to my own land." And Susakim said to him, "Ask any request, and I will give it to you." And Susakim gave to Jeroboam Ano, the elder sister of Thekemina his wife, to be his wife; she was great in the midst of the daughters of the king, and she bore to Jeroboam Abijah his son. And Jeroboam said to Susakim, "Indeed, send me away, and I will depart." So Jeroboam went out of Egypt, and came to the land of Sarira which is in Mount Ephraim; and all the tribe of Ephraim gathered there, and Jeroboam built a palisade there. And his child fell sick with an exceedingly severe sickness; and Jeroboam went to inquire concerning the child; and he said to Ano his wife, "Arise, go; inquire of God concerning the child, whether he will live from his sickness." Now there was a man in Shiloh whose name was Ahijah, and he was sixty years old, and the word of the Lord was with him. And Jeroboam said to his wife, "Arise and take in your hand for the man of God bread, and cakes for his children, and grapes, and a jar of honey." And the woman arose, and took in her hand bread and two cakes and grapes and a jar of honey for Ahijah; and the man was aged, and his eyes had grown dim so that he could not see. And she arose from Sarira and went; and it came to pass, when she came to the city to Ahijah the Shilonite, that Ahijah said to his servant lad, "Go out now to meet Ano the wife of Jeroboam, and you shall say to her, 'Come in and do not stand still, for thus says the Lord: Hard things I am sending upon you.'" And Ano went in to the man of God, and Ahijah said to her, "Why have you brought me bread and grapes and cakes and a jar of honey? Thus says the Lord: Behold, you shall depart from me, and it shall come to pass, when you enter the gate into Sarira, that your maidens will come out to meet you and will say to you, 'The child is dead.' For thus says the Lord: Behold, I will utterly destroy from Jeroboam him who urinates against a wall; and those of Jeroboam who die in the city the dogs shall devour, and him who dies in the field the birds of the air shall devour. And the child shall be mourned with, 'Alas, lord!' because a good word concerning the Lord has been found in him." And the woman departed when she heard it; and it came to pass, as she entered into Sarira, that the child died, and the outcry went forth to meet her. And Jeroboam went to Shechem, which is in Mount Ephraim, and gathered there the tribes of Israel, and Rehoboam the son of Solomon went up there. And the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the Enlamite, saying, "Take for yourself a new garment which has not gone into water, and tear it into twelve pieces; and you shall give them to Jeroboam, and you shall say to him, 'Thus says the Lord: Take for yourself twelve pieces to clothe yourself.'" And Jeroboam took them; and Shemaiah said, "Thus says the Lord concerning the ten tribes of Israel."
